summary: The rank-local row set is divided into a GPU prefix and CPU suffix; the selected GPU kernel is warp-per-row or thread-per-row according to dispatch, and the CPU routine consumes each suffix row's complete CSR interval. The timed runtime loop repeats both disjoint paths for every iteration; GPU copy-back fills its prefix before output gathering. Both final SASS variants were checked. The timed count loop dispatches the GPU thread/warp variants for the GPU row subset and calls the OpenMP spmvCpuRange worker for the complementary CPU suffix on every pass. The main GOMP wrapper has a runtime-count backedge; the outlined worker calculates each owned row across its complete CSR interval and stores the result. Both GPU stubs and terminal SASS stores are included in correction-v2.
